title: Email channel
tagline: Harbor & Vale Travel — a small travel agency whose support is email-first: an inbox-style preview of your mate answering a booking enquiry by mail, threaded, with a calendar invite for the consultation call, an MCP server over the itineraries, WebMCP booking actions, identified-traveller booking lookup, and the Inbox copilot (summarize, draft, send) as the operator's view.
mailbox_note: The real go-live hook is the tenant's connected mailbox (Console → Email → Connect a mailbox, busymate-devtools#3198): once the demo tenant's own inbox is connected and a real inbound mail is answered threaded, set tenant_id, flip status to live here AND in busymate-devtools v2/apps/web/lib/site/demos.ts in the same change. Until then the page is a scaffold — a faithful inbox-style preview with no live loop behind it.
